text:
edulearn_success: Hey Redwood — EduLearn here. We'd like to onboard a domain-adapted multilingual summarizer (EN/ES/FR) that will be used on student-submitted essays and forum posts. Key asks: private deployment (VPC/on-prem option), HSM for KMS, embeddings for search, SLO ~150ms p95 for short summaries, and a canary rollout. Also budget is tight — looking to keep token cost low. Can you advise next steps and an eval plan? Attaching sample anonymized dataset: https://edulearn.example/dataset.zip

 tessa_cs: Thanks for the details! Moving this to intake. Quick clarifying q's: expected peak QPS? (rough estimate) and average summary length in tokens? We need those to size Dedicated vs Private. Also, do you require offline retention of embeddings? :spiral_note_pad:

 edulearn_success: Peak ~40 qps, mostly bursty during grading windows. Avg summary length ~60-120 tokens. Yes, we need embeddings stored for 6 months and per-organization isolation.

 omar_se: FYI, 40 qps with 150ms p95 is ambitious for larger models. Two possible paths:
- smaller instruction-tuned 7B quantized with aggressive batching + caching, or
- 13B int8 on Dedicated GPUs with optimized kernels. For private/on-prem we can pick NIC and GPU options to meet latency. Want me to run a perf estimate?

 edulearn_success: Please run perf estimate. Also need guidance on safety for student PII/PHI redaction — some essays mention sensitive info.

 sangita_ml: For safety/evals: we'll set up a prompt set covering PHI/PII redaction, hallucination checks, and factual consistency for short summaries. Proposed metrics: PII recall/precision, ROUGE-L, embed-similarity for semantic faithfulness, and a human eval slice. Can we get a 1k-sample human eval batch from you?

 edulearn_success: We can provide 1k labeled samples within 2 weeks. Good to include redaction checks.

 omar_se: For canary rollout we recommend: 5% traffic -> 20% -> 100% with automatic rollback on quality regression or latency SLO breach. Canary config example:```json
{
  "canary_steps": [5,20,100],
  "slo_p95_ms": 150,
  "max_regression": 0.05
}```

 tessa_cs: I'll schedule a kickoff next Tue 10am PT with provisioning, security, and ML reps. @ryan_pm please confirm product-side stakeholders for contract addendum re: HSM and 6mo embedding retention.

 ryan_pm: Confirmed — I'll join kickoff and loop legal for the HSM/KMS addendum. Also will check whether embedding retention is an add-on.

 deploy-bot: Availability: Private deployment slot in us-west-2 has capacity starting 2026-04-06. Dedicated burst pool can be provisioned in 3 biz days once commit is signed.

 sangita_ml: Next steps from ML side: (1) perf estimate on 7B vs 13B for 40 qps and 150ms p95 (omar), (2) create eval harness (redaction + faithfulness) and template prompts, (3) define sample labeling instructions for EduLearn. I'll draft the eval plan and share JSON manifest for required sample fields.

 omar_se: I'll put perf numbers + cost delta in a short doc by EOW. For cost savings: consider kv-prefix caching for repeated prompts and embed caching for search to reduce token usage.

 tessa_cs: Great. I'll send the intake form and kickoff calendar invite after perf doc posted. Flagging potential renewal risk: EduLearn is price-sensitive; if costs exceed their forecast we'll need to propose batching/quantization playbook to avoid churn. :warning:

 edulearn_success: Appreciate it — main priority is privacy + predictability. We'll prioritize the labeled samples this week. Thank you all! :raised_hands:
